historical_pricing types

Adjustments

The list of adjustment types (comma delimiter) that tells the system whether to apply or not apply CORAX (Corporate Actions) events or exchange/manual corrections to historical time series data. The supported values of adjustments :

Name Value Description
Adjustments.CCH 'CCH' Apply Capital Change adjustment to historical Pricing due to Corporate Actions e.g. stock split
Adjustments.CRE 'CRE' Apply Currency Redenomination adjustment when there is redenomination of currency
Adjustments.EXCHANGE_CORRECTION 'exchangeCorrection' Apply exchange correction adjustment to historical pricing
Adjustments.MANUAL_CORRECTION 'manualCorrection' Apply manual correction adjustment to historical pricing i.e. annotations made by content analysts
Adjustments.QUALIFIERS 'qualifiers' Apply price or volume adjustment to historical pricing according to trade/quote qualifier summarization actions
Adjustments.RPO 'RPO' Apply Reuters Price Only adjustment to adjust historical price only not volume
Adjustments.RTS 'RTS' Apply Reuters TimeSeries adjustment to adjust both historical price and volume
Adjustments.UNADJUSTED 'unadjusted' Not apply both exchange/manual corrections and CORAX

EventTypes

The list of market events, supported event types are trade, quote and correction.

Name Value Description
EventTypes.CORRECTION 'correction'
EventTypes.QUOTE 'quote'
EventTypes.TRADE 'trade'

MarketSession

The Market Session represents a list of interested official durations in which trade and quote activities occur for a particular instrument.

Name Value Description
MarketSession.NORMAL 'normal'
MarketSession.POST 'post'
MarketSession.PRE 'pre'
